title: Solomon’s Temple, Aizawl
scope: The standing white Solomon’s Temple church in Aizawl, with four crowned corner spires, tall pointed façades, colonnaded porch and immediate podium.
limitations: The mapped church and porch fix the geographic outline. Roof ridge heights, crown silhouettes, small icons and the stair flights are reconstructed estimates.
The four façades follow the documented repeated arrangement. The other views, construction joints and carved surfaces are simplified.
